title: Acyclicity of the single-coordinate Kummer tower in a strict semistable local chart
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $A=\mathbf F_\ell$. A trait means $\operatorname{Spec}R$ for a Noetherian local domain $R$ of dimension one with principal maximal ideal $(\pi)$. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in $R$. For integers $n\ge1$ and $m\ge0$, set
$$B=R[T_1,\ldots,T_n,Y_1,\ldots,Y_m]/(T_1\cdots T_n-\pi),\qquad X=\operatorname{Spec}B.$$
Polynomial rings and spectra are [def-weil-polynomial-ring, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Fix $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ whose image lies in $V(T_i)$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $C=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x}$ be the coordinate ring of the strict localization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], let $t_i$ be the image of $T_i$, and put
$$V_r=\operatorname{Spec}\bigl(C[1/t_i,u_r]/(u_r^{\ell^r}-t_i)\bigr)\quad(r\ge0).$$
The transition $V_{r+1}\to V_r$ sends $u_r$ to $u_{r+1}^{\ell}$; $V_0$ identifies with $\operatorname{Spec}C[1/t_i]$. Write $H^q$ for ordinary small-etale cohomology with the constant sheaf $A$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every $r$ the constant-section map $A\to H^0(V_r,A)$ is an isomorphism, and
$$\varinjlim_{r\ge0} H^q(V_r,A)=0\qquad(q>0),$$
where the transition maps on cohomology are pullbacks. No excellence, completeness or henselianity of $R$ is assumed.
